students.answer: The header in IPv6 has a fixed length and is designed to be used for easy processing, it only contains information needed for routing. Any additional information is stored in extension headers. They carry optional information and can be found in between the fixed header and the playload. Since the whole IPv6 packet is only allowed a certain size, these additional extension headers take up space of the payload. The main advantage of extension headers is that they can be added optionally and help to overcome size limitation.

Extension Headers are extensions for the normal header. You can support multiple addresses or specify more options for your header and packet, like e.g. authentication.

The Extension Headers are located between the normal header and the payload, they will be attached to the normal header. 

The biggest advantage of Extension Headers is the possibility to use broadcasting.
